metadata.name: riff_passport
metadata.description: Artist Passport: a multi-proof, passkey-protected on-chain identity for musicians

accounts.name: verifier
docs: riff's verifier, co-signing as riff's `claim_artist` requires.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run the config.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The artist's new wallet, with fresh proofs of its own.

accounts.name: new_wallet
docs: Signs too, so a typo can't send the passport to a wallet nobody holds.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program upgrade authority

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Signer is not the passport config admin

errors.name: NotVerifier
errors.msg: Signer is not riff's verifier

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Invalid config value

errors.name: InvalidArtistId
errors.msg: Artist ID must be spotify: plus a 22-character Spotify ID

errors.name: ProofMismatch

errors.name: ProofExpired
errors.msg: A proof is too old; prove it again

errors.name: NotEnoughProofs
errors.msg: Needs at least 2 proofs from different sources, including a strong one

errors.name: TooManyProofs
errors.msg: Too many proofs

errors.name: Revoked
errors.msg: The passport has been revoked

errors.name: NotPassportWallet
errors.msg: Signer is not the passport's wallet

errors.name: PasskeyMissing
errors.msg: No matching passkey signature in this transaction

errors.name: PasskeyWrongChallenge
errors.msg: The passkey signature is for a different action

errors.name: PasskeyWrongSite
errors.msg: The passkey signature is for a different site

errors.name: PasskeyNotVerified
errors.msg: The passkey wasn't used with the user present and verified

errors.name: PasskeyMalformed
errors.msg: Malformed passkey data

errors.name: RecoveryPending
errors.msg: A recovery is already pending

errors.name: NoRecovery
errors.msg: No recovery is pending

errors.name: RecoveryLocked
errors.msg: The recovery time-lock hasn't passed yet

errors.name: NotAGuardian
errors.msg: This proof can't veto the recovery

errors.name: PasskeyRequired
errors.msg: Withdrawal needs the passkey

errors.name: InsufficientVault
errors.msg: The vault doesn't hold that much

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: OnProbation

errors.name: NotRevoked

types.name: Endorsement
docs: The artist's word on one coin, on any launchpad.

types.name: PasskeyProof
docs: The parts of a WebAuthn assertion the program needs; the signature and
public key travel in the precompile instruction.

types.name: Passport
docs: An artist's verified identity. Keyed by artist ID, so there's one per artist.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Counts passkey actions; part of every challenge, so no signature works twice.

fields.name: verifier
docs: riff's verification service. It checks proofs off-chain (a Spotify
for Artists email, the Spotify bio code, YouTube, a website), attests
them here, and co-signs riff claims.

fields.name: rp_id_hash
docs: sha256 of the passkey site (the WebAuthn relying party, e.g. "riffpad.fun").

fields.name: recovery_delay
docs: How long a recovery waits before it can be finalized, in seconds.
A new or reissued passport waits as long before it can endorse or
withdraw (its probation), so a takeover has the same public window.

fields.name: free_withdraw_per_day
docs: How much may leave a vault per day without the passkey, in lamports.

fields.name: proof_max_age
docs: How recent proofs must be to issue or recover a passport, in seconds.

types.name: ProofKind
docs: The ways an artist can prove who they are.

types.name: ProofRecord
docs: One verified proof that `wallet` speaks for `artist_id`. Proofs are kept
per wallet, so nobody can block an artist by proving first.

fields.name: source_hash
docs: Hash of what was checked (the email's signature, the bio code, a channel ID, a domain).

types.name: Vault
docs: Holds the artist's fees from every coin they claimed through the passport.
It is the "artist" on those coins, and only this program can pay out of it.
